'''Tendaar Bel''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who worked under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] before he was freed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He then was recruited into the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] project, and after scrambling IFF codes at the [[assault on Cardooine]], he was assigned to [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]]. He helped [[Takeover at Whisper Base|capture]] [[Whisper Base]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tendaar Bel appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] [[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base'']].
